is_normalized.description: Whether the cam_zones coordinates are normalized (0.0-1.0) or absolute pixel values.

max_miss.description: Number of processing frames the tracker keeps a lost ID before discarding. Wall-clock seconds = max_miss / (fps / frame_interval).

fps.description: Frames per second of the camera stream, used to convert frame_id to seconds.

items.description: Each point is [x, y] (normalized if is_normalized=true).
Each point is [x, y] (normalized if is_normalized=true).

violent_count.description: Minimum stationary seconds before firing (main threshold).

near_violation_window.description: Seconds to wait for near-violation pallets that will violate soon before emitting an event.

max_wait_time.description: Maximum batching time in seconds before forcing the violation report to be sent.

heartbeat_interval.description: Interval in seconds between heartbeat summary logs of pallets on floor.

realert_interval.description: Seconds to wait before re-alerting on a previously reported violation (-1 disables).

reported_region_expiry.description: Seconds a reported-pallet dedup region is kept for adopting a re-acquired track on the same spot before it ages out. Defaults to violent_count. The region is also cleared immediately when its own track moves off the spot.

confidence_threshold.description: Detections with confidence below this are dropped before tracking (0 disables). Default 0.3 filters noisy low-confidence detections.

walking_zone_pallet_ioa.description: Walking-zone check for pallet (flat, bbox ~= floor footprint). 0 (default) checks a single bottom-center point; >0 requires this fraction of the whole bbox area inside a walking_zone (1.0 = fully inside). Cuts false positives from pallets only clipping a zone edge.

walking_zone_overlap_ratio.description: Walking-zone check for product_package (tall, only its base touches the floor). 0 (default) checks a single bottom-center point; >0 requires this fraction of the bbox's bottom base_height_fraction slice area inside a walking_zone. Cuts false positives from tall bboxes clipping narrow/jagged walking_zones.

walking_zone_base_height_fraction.description: Fraction of the product_package bbox height (from the bottom) used as its floor-contact base slice for walking_zone_overlap_ratio. Default 0.25.

target_class.description: Detector classes accumulated as pallet/package observations.
